title: An override pass lifts the SendMessage wording judge
why: Oct 26: your 10-minute override did nothing; a cross-account ping was blocked three times by a judge that never sees the pass.
note: Cause: the SendMessage wording judge was a prompt-type hook in settings.json. A prompt hook sees only the call's JSON, so it cannot read the override pass, and a command hook cannot stop a sibling hook. Ruling, Oct 26 15:28 CDT (shiv, "Fix the hook"), recorded in decision owner-override-pass. Fix: the wording judge runs in hooks/sendmessage_state.py with the same prompt and model, and any deny goes through guard_core.refuse(), the one place that reads the pass. Built in PR #645 (red on main's hook, 20 checks; two Sonnet review rounds, clear) and merged in batch #649 (main 2ad85de6). Left: the owner re-runs the live cross-account ping test with the brief in ask (briefs/c82-cross-account-ping-retest.md); the step closes on its verdict. Port: no; these hooks install from claude-settings to every repo already. Placed ahead of c77 (triage, Oct 26). You marked the ping test done, Oct 27 23:48 CDT (waiting page item 5), with no verdict in the note. Waits on: the sending session's guard.log lines (override let the ping through; a bare ping is denied); it closes on them.
ask:
# c82: re-run the cross-account ping test

Paste the block below, whole, into the sending session: the one on the account where your ping was
blocked. Written by the local liaison, Oct 27, against claude-settings main 2ad85de6 (batch #649,
which carries PR #645).

```
Re-run the cross-account ping test for c82 (an override pass lifts the SendMessage wording judge). Do nothing else.
1. Pull claude-settings to 2ad85de6 or later and reinstall. Then confirm ~/.claude/settings.json has no "Judge this SendMessage" prompt hook, and that the SendMessage command hook's timeout is 50. If either check fails, stop and report.
2. Wait for me to type an override (for example "override 10m"). Then send the same ping as before to the session on my other account.
3. Expect it to go through, with a guard.log line "override parallelism-no-mid-task-talk".
4. After the override ends, send one bare chatter ping with no override. Expect a deny, which shows the judge still works.
Report the guard.log lines and the verdict of each send, not the transcript. Five lines at most.
```
